identity.name: @epdoc/exif
identity.purpose: Read/write EXIF metadata via the exiftool binary with GPS parsing, date resolution, reverse geocoding, and stripped-date repair

quickStart.pattern: readFiles(paths) → File.resolver for dates → File.applyTags() + write() for updates

exports.name: File
exports.description: Wraps a single file's EXIF metadata; typed getters, GPS, and an idempotent write queue (skips unchanged tags)
exports.whenToUse: Reading or writing tags on a specific file

exports.name: readFiles
exports.description: Bulk EXIF read in one exiftool invocation; returns one File per input path
exports.whenToUse: Reading metadata for one or more files efficiently

exports.name: Meta.Resolver
exports.description: Media-agnostic date resolution and write-prepare methods with fallback chains across EXIF/QuickTime/XMP/IPTC/GPS tags
exports.whenToUse: Getting standardized dates/dimensions/duration/codec/producer regardless of file type

exports.name: Meta.Parse
exports.description: Parsers for exiftool values: dateString, duration, focalLength, fNumber, exposureTime, fileSize, bitrate, milliseconds, json

exports.name: Geo.AddressLookup
exports.description: Nominatim reverse-geocode client; converts GPS coordinates to Adobe-Bridge-compatible EXIF location tags (Country/CountryCode/State/City/Sublocation)
exports.whenToUse: Looking up locations and writing location tags (via File.setAddressFromLookup)

exports.name: Geo.Level
exports.description: Location detail levels controlling which tags are written: country | state | county | city | sublocation | exact

exports.name: Gps.parse / Gps.toDms
exports.description: Convert DMS/numeric GPS values to decimal degrees and back to exiftool DMS strings

exports.name: File.repair
exports.description: Restore dates stripped by WhatsApp/TikTok from filesystem/filename timestamps; writes a Software producer tag
exports.whenToUse: Batch-fixing downloaded media with missing embedded dates

exports.name: dateFromFilename
exports.description: Extract a wall-clock DateTime from media filenames (WhatsApp mobile/macOS, Signal, epoch-ms, generic YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS)
exports.whenToUse: Deriving a capture date from a filename, e.g. WhatsApp repair fallback

exports.name: MetaModHistory
exports.description: Report of a queued write: { tag, value, previousValue }; returned by File.write/repair for dry-run reporting
exports.whenToUse: Reporting what a write or repair would change

exports.name: Metadata
exports.description: Typed JSON exiftool emits for one file; union of EXIF, IPTC, XMP, video, and document tag families

patterns.name: Read-only inspection
patterns.when: Getting standardized dates/dimensions/duration from any media type

patterns.name: Idempotent write
patterns.when: Setting dates/tags that may already match the file

patterns.name: Dry-run reporting
patterns.code:
const file = new Exif.File(path, { dryRun: true });
const mods = await file.repair(); // report mod.tag: previousValue -> value
